comments.author: @johntomasik1555
comments.text:
Great street food there.  Pretty much true everywhere in Taiwan.  Never had a bad dish.  That 3 cup chicken is something easily made at home here in the States.  They also make a variety of pig intestines (also found elsewhere in Taiwan).  It's a good snack to eat if one has a hangover...lol.

A guy from the States saw me in Keelung and came running over, so happy to see me.  He was a Christian there to pimp his religion (on a "mission").  I told him to go back home.  The people are too wonderful, honorable, and peaceful to try to change them into us.  We'd be doing them a disservice.
